'''Phylon Freight''' was the manufacturer of the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] and the [[CT-11 space tug]]. It was either the mother company or a subdivision of [[Phylon Transport/Legends|Phylon Transport]].
